title: Olive
sourceLines: -Branch of, brought by the dove to Noah’s ark Ge 8:11
-Common to the land of Canaan Ex 23:11; De 6:11; 8:8
-Israelites commanded to cultivate in the land of promise De 28:40
-Precepts concerning gleaning the fruit of De 24:20; Isa 17:6
-The cherubs made of the wood of 1Ki 6:23,31-33
.The wild, a figure of the Gentiles; the cultivated, of the Jews Ro 11:17-21,24
.Oil extracted from, used as illuminating oil in the tabernacle Ex 39:37; Le 24:2; Zec 4:12
